name: Chasing Crowns
source:
You, as the story's hero, must find a way to survive in one of the world's harshest environments: a reality TV game show. The show, called Common Knowledge, is on it's third season - and this year, there's a twist. You are the only male contestant, locked alone in a house with twelve beautiful girls.

With one contestant exiled by the house court each week, you must carefully choose friends and form alliances. But be careful - the Common Knowledge house holds its own secrets, and soon it becomes clear that something isn't right. With the prying eyes of hidden cameras watching your every move, your battle for survival in the game turns more real than you could have ever imagined.

Will you succeed in Chasing Crowns, or will fate let another claim your throne?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/projectPS]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
作为故事的英雄，你必须找到一种方法在世界上最恶劣的环境之一：电视游戏真人秀节目中生存。这部名为《常识》的节目已进入第三季，而今年，情况有所不同。你是唯一的男性参赛者，被独自锁在一个有十二个美丽女孩的房子里。

每周都会有一名参赛者被宫廷流放，你必须仔细选择朋友并结成联盟。但要小心 - 常识屋拥有自己的秘密，很快就会发现有些事情不对劲。隐藏摄像头监视着你的一举一动，你在游戏中的生存之战变得比你想象的更加真实。

你会成功追逐王冠，还是命运会让别人夺走你的王位？
